Imports

core

Types

FilesystemPolicy = ref object of StorageDriver
A security layer wrapping an underlying StorageDriver. Every operation is checked against a set of PolicyRules before being delegated, and violations raise a FilesystemPolicyError. 
FilesystemPolicyError = object of StorageError
  operation*: string
  rule*: string
Raised when an operation violates a filesystem policy. Carries the offending operation and the rule that was violated. 
PolicyRules = object
  readOnly*: bool            ## deny all mutating operations (write, delete, move, ...)
  maxFileSize*: int64        ## maximum bytes for a single file; 0 = unlimited
  maxPathLength*: int        ## maximum characters in a path; 0 = unlimited
  maxDepth*: int             ## maximum number of path segments; 0 = unlimited
  denyHiddenFiles*: bool ## block creation of hidden files, deny reading them, and filter them
                         ## from listings. `exists` still reports them (read access to the fact
                         ## of existence is allowed); only content and metadata reads are denied.
  allowedExtensions*: seq[string] ## allowed file extensions without the leading dot; empty = allow all
  allowedMimeTypes*: seq[string] ## allowed MIME types (inferred from the extension via mimedb);
                                 ## empty = allow all
Configurable rules enforced by a FilesystemPolicy. Zero / empty values mean "no restriction".

method exists(p: FilesystemPolicy; path: string): bool {.
    ...raises: [FilesystemPolicyError, StorageError], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Existence is not access-filtered: the suite pins that exists (like list membership for the queried path itself) still works for hidden files — "read access allowed". Denial happens at read/metadata time, and listings/search filter denied entries out.
